summary: Mobile-health Network Solutions filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Board approved the issuance of 1,120,000 Class A ordinary shares to 39 key personnel as part of their fiscal year 2027 remuneration. The shares are subject to transfer restrictions under a deed of undertaking. This is a routine equity compensation matter, not a special situation. No price, premium, or deal structure is involved. What to watch: potential dilution from the new shares and any insider selling activity, though the restrictions limit immediate transfers.
